messages:
maria_cs: heads-up — we need a short customer-facing brief for the accounts impacted by the inference throttling this morning. low churn risk but several onboarding customers hit. draft in thread below, need sign-off before we send.
noah_ops: saw the alert, thanks. engineering says root cause is autoscaler mis-tuning on the dedicated pools, causing sticky workers. fix is deployed to canary, rolling to prod now. ETA for full mitigation ~45m.
maria_cs: ok can we put that ETA in the note? customers will want concrete next steps. also we should include what data (if any) was persisted/affected.
incident-bot: Incident INC-2026-214 created — "dedicated-pool-autoscaler-degradation". Severity: S2. Link: https://incidents.redwood.internal/INC-2026-214
dev_pmo: cc @maria_cs @noah_ops — engineering confirms no data loss. Only inference latency and 5xx spikes for 12-50% of requests during window 08:12–09:05 UTC. We'll include a timeline in the RCA.
james_support: I've pulled the active tickets list — 18 active cases flagged as "performance" by reps. Top 6 accounts are on onboarding plans (MVP stage). I can triage and add short notes for each.
tina_success_manager: For those 6 onboarding accounts, suggest proactive 1:1 outreach. We should offer a temporary priority routing to hosted and a 1-week credit to offset impact. Thoughts?
noah_ops: priority routing is doable for the accounts in Dedicated -> route to hosted model variant for next 24h. I'll need account IDs by EOD to create routing policy.
maria_cs: draft message below. keep it concise. please comment inline.

maria_cs: "Hi [FirstName],

We're writing to let you know about an incident earlier today that affected inference performance for a subset of Dedicated customers. What happened: an autoscaler regression caused a portion of requests to experience elevated latency and intermittent 5xx responses between 08:12–09:05 UTC. Impact: some of your inbound requests may have failed or been delayed during that window. What we did: engineers rolled a fix within 45 minutes and we validated service stability across regions. What we're doing for you: we can enable temporary routing to our hosted inference for 24 hours and apply a one-week service credit to your account. Next steps: if you'd like priority routing, reply with "OPT_IN" and we'll enable it within 1 hour. Full technical RCA will follow within 72 hours. We apologize for the disruption and are available to walk through the details. — Maria, Customer Success"

noah_ops: looks good. I'd change "one-week service credit" to a specific % or dollar amount? Ops prefers "one-week credit equivalent to average weekly usage" so it's precise.
maria_cs: good call — update: "one-week service credit equivalent to your average weekly inference spend." I'll mark that.
james_support: add a line about how to escalate: "If this incident has materially impacted your launch metrics, reply with ESCALATE and we'll schedule a prioritized review with Eng + CS." Keeps replies structured.
tina_success_manager: +1 on scheduled review option. Also can we attach a short FAQ with common Qs: timeline, impact, how to opt in, contact.
dev_pmo: I'll assemble the timeline and a minimal RCA skeleton: root cause, mitigation steps taken, long-term fix, verification. Will drop link when ready: https://docs.redwood.internal/rca/INC-2026-214-draft
maria_cs: perfect. next: personalization. james — can you export contact names and account IDs for the 18 ticketed customers and highlight the 6 onboarding ones? prefer CSV with columns: account_name, account_id, primary_contact, weekly_avg_spend.
james_support: on it. expect CSV in 20m.
noah_ops: when we enable routing for any account, we'll need the account_id and desired window. API call snippet I'll use:

```
POST /admin/routing
{
  "account_id": "acct_XXXX",
  "target": "hosted",
  "duration_hours": 24
}
```

I'll run in maintenance mode and post confirmation messages.
maria_cs: timeline for outreach: I want personalized notes to top-6 within 1 hour, batch note to remaining flagged customers within 3 hours. Can everyone commit?
james_support: yes — I can have contact list in 20m and help send.
tina_success_manager: I'll prepare the FAQ and a short checklist for the CSMs: <opt-in steps>, <escalation steps>, <credit FAQ>. ETA 45m.
dev_pmo: RCA skeleton complete, pushing draft now. Link: https://docs.redwood.internal/rca/INC-2026-214-draft (permissions open for redwood/*)
noah_ops: started canary -> prod rollout. first 10% of traffic moved at 09:04, no regressions observed. posting rollout logs in #eng-runtime.
maria_cs: thanks everyone. once I send the first two personalized notes I'll paste them here for review. keep replies short and procedural — we need to move fast. :thumbsup:
james_support: CSV uploaded: https://files.redwood.internal/cs/incident-1850426789-contacts.csv — flagged 6 onboarding accounts in column "onboarding_flag".
maria_cs: got it. drafting top-6 notes now.

maria_cs: DRAFT for onboarding account A (please review): "Hi Jordan — we noticed some degraded responses this morning that may have impacted your initial fine-tuning tests. We've applied a fix and can route your workloads to hosted for 24h if you'd like to continue testing uninterrupted. We'll also apply a one-week service credit equal to your typical weekly usage. Reply OPT_IN to accept priority routing or ESCALATE to request a walkthrough with Eng + CS. — Maria"

tina_success_manager: nit: change "initial fine-tuning tests" to "onboarding evaluation runs" — clearer for PMs.
noah_ops: once you get OPT_IN, send account_id to me and I'll trigger routing.
james_support: sending threads now for top-6. I'll CC CSMs on each.
maria_cs: sent to top-2, here's response from customer-1: "Thanks, OPT_IN — please enable ASAP." No other replies yet.
noah_ops: enabled routing for acct_82b7 — confirmation: routing enabled, will expire 24h from 09:12 UTC.
maria_cs: updated sent status in spreadsheet. I'll continue with remaining four.

maria_cs: follow-up plan: scheduled check-in 24h after routing start, include performance metrics snapshot. if customers request credits now, CS team to log in Billing as "incident credit" with tag INC-2026-214 — I'll add instructions in the checklist.
dev_pmo: long-term action items: 1) revert autoscaler regression and add e2e test, 2) improved alerting for sticky workers, 3) run capacity simulations monthly. Assigned to eng-runtime and infra.
noah_ops: closing loop on engineering: patch merged, tests green, monitoring alarms adjusted. I'll post final status once rollout reaches 100%.
maria_cs: thanks team. after 100% rollout and a small QA pass on the RCA I'll send the formal customer-notice and the full RCA link. Leaving this thread open for updates. :sparkles:
